run: abcd-standard (A at 6000 tokens — default for testing going forward since 2026-10-11)

sampling.note: llama-cli defaults for top_p/top_k; temp 0.3 matches all prior suite runs

prompts.label: Code Generation
prompts.prompt: Write a Python function called `merge_sort` that takes a list of integers and returns a new list sorted in ascending order. Include type hints, a docstring, and handle edge cases (empty list, single element). Then show an example usage.
prompts.grade_key: Correct divide-conquer-merge; type hints; docstring; empty/single edge cases; example usage

prompts.label: Iambic Pentameter
prompts.prompt: Write a poem about the changing of seasons from autumn to winter, strictly in iambic pentameter (10 syllables per line, alternating stress). Write exactly 8 lines with an ABAB CDCD rhyme scheme.
prompts.grade_key: Exactly 8 lines; 10 syllables/line; iambic stress; ABAB CDCD rhyme

prompts.label: Clinical Prose
prompts.prompt: Explain the pathophysiology of Hashimoto's thyroiditis in detail. Cover the autoimmune mechanism, the role of anti-TPO antibodies, the progression from euthyroid to hypothyroid, and the typical lab findings at each stage. Write for a medical student audience.
prompts.grade_key: All 4 required elements covered; medically accurate; med-student register

prompts.label: Creative Writing
prompts.prompt: Write a short scene (200-300 words) set in a lighthouse during a storm. The lighthouse keeper is an old woman who has been alone for thirty years. A stranger arrives at the door, drenched and shivering. Show, don't tell — use sensory details and subtext.
prompts.grade_key: 200-300 words; keeper persona; stranger arrival; show-don't-tell; sensory detail

prompts.label: Mathematical Proof
prompts.prompt: Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational. Use a proof by contradiction. State each step clearly with justification. Begin with: 'Theorem: sqrt(2) is irrational.'
prompts.grade_key: Opens with required theorem line; valid contradiction; even/odd argument correct; clear steps

prompts.label: HTML/CSS Web Page
prompts.prompt: Create a complete HTML page with embedded CSS for a personal portfolio website. Include a header with navigation, a hero section with name and tagline, an about section, a projects grid with 3 sample project cards, and a footer with contact links. Use modern CSS with flexbox, a color scheme of dark blue and gold, and responsive design with a media query for mobile.
prompts.grade_key: All 5 sections; flexbox; dark blue/gold scheme; media query; valid HTML

prompts.label: Python Data Processing
prompts.prompt: Write a Python class called DataProcessor that loads a CSV file of employee records (columns: name, department, salary, hire_date), filters employees hired after 2020, calculates average salary by department, finds the top 3 highest paid employees, and exports results to a JSON file. Include type hints, docstrings, error handling, and use the csv and json standard library modules. Show example usage.
prompts.grade_key: Executable; all 5 behaviors; type hints; docstrings; error handling; csv+json modules

prompts.label: C System Programming
prompts.prompt: Write a C program that implements a simple thread-safe queue using a linked list. Include functions: queue_init, queue_push, queue_pop, queue_size, and queue_destroy. Use pthread mutex for thread safety. Include a main function that demonstrates creating the queue, pushing 5 integers, and popping them all. Add proper error handling and memory management (free on destroy).
prompts.grade_key: All 5 functions; pthread mutex; demo main; frees memory; error handling

prompts.label: TRS-80 BASIC Retro Game
prompts.prompt: Write a TRS-80 Model III BASIC program for a simple text adventure game. The player explores 3 rooms (Entrance Hall, Library, Treasure Room) looking for a golden key. Use PRINT for room descriptions, INPUT for player commands (GO NORTH, GO SOUTH, TAKE KEY, EXAMINE), string variables for room descriptions, and GOTO for navigation. Include inventory tracking and a win condition when the player takes the key and reaches the Treasure Room. Number lines starting at 10 with increments of 10.
prompts.grade_key: TRS-80 dialect (line numbers 10+10, GOTO, no modern constructs); 3 rooms; INPUT; inventory; win condition

prompts.label: Julia Numerical Computing
prompts.prompt: Write a Julia program that implements the Newton-Raphson method for finding roots of a function. Create a function newton_raphson(f, df, x0, tol, max_iter) that takes a function, its derivative, initial guess, tolerance, and max iterations. Use it to find the root of x^3 - 2x - 5 (starting at x0=2.0). Print each iteration showing the step number, current x, f(x), and the error. Include type annotations and a docstring. Show the final result.
prompts.grade_key: Correct signature; iteration table; root ~2.0946; type annotations; docstring

prompts.label: HTML Profile Cards Page
prompts.prompt: Create a complete HTML page with CSS that displays 3 profile cards side by side. Each card should have a circular avatar placeholder, a name, a job title, and a short bio. Use flexbox for layout. Include hover effects on the cards. Make it responsive so cards stack vertically on mobile. Return only the HTML file.
prompts.grade_key: 10: complete, responsive, hover, clean CSS. 7-8: most features. 5-6: basic, missing responsive/hover. 3-4: broken layout. 1-2: not HTML

prompts.label: HTML Web Browser Game
prompts.prompt: Create a single HTML file with JavaScript for a simple click-the-target game. A colored circle appears at random positions on a canvas. The player clicks it to score points. Show the score, a 30-second timer, and a game over screen with final score. Include a start button. Return only the HTML file.
prompts.grade_key: 10: working game, all features. 7-8: mostly working, minor bugs. 5-6: missing timer/score. 3-4: broken JS. 1-2: not a game

prompts.label: Python Data Processing
prompts.prompt: Write a Python function called process_grades that takes a list of dictionaries, where each dict has 'name' and 'score' keys. The function should: 1) Calculate the average score, 2) Find the highest and lowest scorers, 3) Return a summary dict with avg_score, top_student, and bottom_student. Include type hints and a docstring. Include a test example.
prompts.grade_key: 10: correct, hints, docstring, test, edge cases. 7-8: correct, missing one element. 5-6: basic-case works. 3-4: broken logic. 1-2: not Python

prompts.label: Iambic Pentameter Poem
prompts.prompt: Write a 6-line poem in strict iambic pentameter about a lighthouse keeper watching a storm. Each line must have exactly 10 syllables with the da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM da-DUM rhythm. Do not add extra commentary. Return only the poem.
prompts.grade_key: 10: exactly 6 lines, perfect meter, imagery. 7-8: 6 lines, 1-2 syllable errors. 5-6: inconsistent meter. 3-4: wrong line count. 1-2: not a poem

prompts.label: Mathematical Proof
prompts.prompt: Prove that the sum of the first n natural numbers equals n(n+1)/2. Use mathematical induction. Show the base case, the inductive hypothesis, and the inductive step clearly. Return only the proof.
prompts.grade_key: 10: correct base case, hypothesis, step, notation. 7-8: correct, minor issues. 5-6: one step unclear. 3-4: major errors. 1-2: not a proof

prompts.label: Creative Writing - Short Story
prompts.prompt: Write a 200-word short story about a musician who discovers their old guitar can play memories. The story should have a clear beginning, middle, and end. Use vivid sensory details. Return only the story.
prompts.grade_key: 10: compelling arc, sensory, ~200 words. 7-8: good, slightly off count. 5-6: weak arc, far from count. 3-4: barely a story. 1-2: off-topic

prompts.label: Function Call: Web Search
prompts.prompt: I need to find recent news about renewable energy breakthroughs. Search the web for the latest developments in solar and wind technology from this month.
prompts.grade_key: 10: calls web_search, well-formed query about renewables. 7-8: calls, query could be better. 5-6: mentions but no call. 3-4: answers from memory. 1-2: off-topic

prompts.label: Function Call: Terminal Command
prompts.prompt: Check the disk usage on my system and tell me how much free space is left on the root partition.
prompts.grade_key: 10: calls terminal with df -h or equivalent. 7-8: right idea, wrong syntax. 5-6: mentions, no call. 3-4: generic answer. 1-2: off-topic

prompts.label: Function Call: Write File
prompts.prompt: Create a file called todo.txt in my home directory with these items: 1. Buy groceries 2. Call dentist 3. Fix the sink. Save it to ~/todo.txt.
prompts.grade_key: 10: write_file, correct path, all 3 items. 7-8: path/content slightly off. 5-6: mentions, no call. 3-4: instructions only. 1-2: off-topic

prompts.label: Function Call: Read File
prompts.prompt: Read the contents of /etc/hostname and tell me what it says.
prompts.grade_key: 10: read_file with /etc/hostname. 7-8: right tool, wrong path. 5-6: mentions, no call. 3-4: guesses. 1-2: off-topic

prompts.label: Function Call: SQLite Query
prompts.prompt: Query the database at clinic.db for all patients seen in the last 30 days. Show me their names and visit dates.
prompts.grade_key: 10: proper SQLite query with date filter. 7-8: query, date logic off. 5-6: mentions SQL, no call. 3-4: generic advice. 1-2: off-topic

prompts.label: Function Call: Email Draft
prompts.prompt: Draft an email to my colleague Sarah about rescheduling our Thursday meeting to Monday at 2pm. The email should be professional and brief.
prompts.grade_key: 10: subject, greeting, body, sign-off; professional; brief; clear reschedule. 7-8: missing subject or verbose. 5-6: structure/tone issues. 3-4: no structure. 1-2: off-topic

prompts.label: Counting r's in strawberry
prompts.prompt: How many r's are in the word strawberry?
prompts.grade_key: Correct answer: 3

prompts.label: Counting e's in elephant
prompts.prompt: How many e's are in the word elephant?
prompts.grade_key: Correct answer: 2

prompts.label: Farmer sheep
prompts.prompt: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 die. How many sheep are left?
prompts.grade_key: Correct answer: 9

prompts.label: Bat and ball
prompts.prompt: A bat and a ball cost $1.10 total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much is the ball?
prompts.grade_key: Correct answer: $0.05

prompts.label: Sum 1 to 100
prompts.prompt: What is the sum of all integers from 1 to 100?
prompts.grade_key: Correct answer: 5050

prompts.label: sqrt(2) irrational (short phrasing)
prompts.prompt: Prove that sqrt(2) is irrational.
prompts.grade_key: Valid contradiction proof; compare with a_math (same task, terser prompt)

prompts.label: 3 light switches
prompts.prompt: You have 3 light switches outside a closed room with 3 bulbs. You may enter once. How do you match switches to bulbs?
prompts.grade_key: Heat trick: turn on 1&2, wait, turn off 2, enter — on=1, off-warm=2, off-cold=3

prompts.label: Mislabeled boxes
prompts.prompt: There are 3 boxes: one has only apples, one only oranges, one both. Labels are all wrong. With one draw from one box, can you relabel correctly?
prompts.grade_key: Draw from box labeled 'both'; it is single-fruit; derive other two by exclusion

prompts.label: Binary search explanation
prompts.prompt: Explain step by step how a binary search finds an element in a sorted array.
prompts.grade_key: Correct mid/compare/halve loop; O(log n); sorted precondition

prompts.label: Fibonacci memoization
prompts.prompt: Write a function that returns the nth Fibonacci number using memoization.
prompts.grade_key: Correct memoized implementation

prompts.label: Fermi: piano tuners
prompts.prompt: Estimate how many piano tuners are in a city of 1 million people.
prompts.grade_key: Reasonable Fermi chain (pianos/households, tuning frequency, tuner capacity); order of magnitude ~10-100

prompts.label: Why ice floats
prompts.prompt: Why does ice float on water?
prompts.grade_key: Density anomaly, hydrogen-bond lattice expansion, ~9% volume increase
